name: Visual Engine Registry
purpose: specs/visual-engines.json: the engines a scene can route to, their roles and costs, routing signals (treatment, subject and form terms), composition modes, plate defaults, the pinned Blender builds with SHA-256, and the engines not adopted.

compatibility.notes: Edit routing terms here, not in code.

security.notes: Static data; download URLs point at download.blender.org with pinned hashes.
